questions.prompt: What did Chips and Bella do in the garden?
choices: Bella watched Chips, and Chips went to sleep.
Bella hid from Chips, and Chips left the garden.
Bella chased Chips, and Chips chased Bella.
questions.answer: Bella chased Chips, and Chips chased Bella.
questions.evidenceText: Bella chased Chips. Chips chased Bella. They ran round and round the garden at an absolutely ridiculous speed.

questions.prompt: Why were James and Anna soaked?
questions.evidenceText: Bella crashed into the paddling pool. Water exploded in every direction. James and Anna were completely soaked.

questions.prompt: What showed that Chips and Bella liked each other?
choices: Chips hid from Bella, and Bella left the garden.
Chips licked Bella, and Bella licked Chips.
Chips growled at Bella, and Bella growled back.
questions.answer: Chips licked Bella, and Bella licked Chips.
questions.rationale: Chips and Bella lick each other, and Anna then says she thinks they like each other, so the mutual licks show friendly affection.
questions.evidenceText: At last, both Chips and Bella lay down on the lawn side by side, panting. Chips licked Bella's ear. Bella licked Chips's nose.

supportingEvidence.evidenceText: I think they like each other
